import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_3.csv"
]

# List to hold the 'occluded' column from each source
occluded_columns = []

# Load each source file, extract the 'occluded' column, and append to the list
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Extract only the 'occluded' column as integer type
    occluded_series = df['occluded'].astype(int)
    occluded_columns.append(occluded_series)

# Concatenate all occluded columns vertically (union)
target_df = pd.concat(occluded_columns, ignore_index=True).to_frame(name='occluded')

# Save the resulting DataFrame to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
